visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long reddish-brown hair wearing a black lace two-piece outfit stands in a night urban plaza. She holds a microphone toward three individuals wearing large, plush beer mug hats. The background is a brightly lit outdoor area with modern architecture and passers-by. (2) The scene cuts to the woman showing a black tablet to three people in cosplay, including one dressed as the character Hisoka with red hair and face paint. They lean in closely, looking at the screen with focused expressions. (3) The woman interviews two individuals in Jojo's Bizarre Adventure cosplay; one has blue lips and a star-patterned hat, the other wears a wide-brimmed brown hat. They are wearing earphones connected to the tablet, smiling and gesturing as they listen. (4) A group of five men dressed in traditional, colorful Chinese magistrate-style robes with large fanned headpieces stand together. They hold traditional fans, laughing and reacting toward the camera while the main woman creator stands nearby. (5) The woman creator stands with a group of six people dressed in teal Squirtle-style turtle costumes. They all wear black sunglasses and stand in a row in front of a department store building at night. (6) A group of five people in traditional Qing Dynasty-style vampire (Jiangshi) costumes stands still with pale face makeup. The woman creator stands in the middle of them, holding a microphone and speaking with an expressive face. (7) The woman creator stands close to a girl with braided hair and heavy, dark makeup. She touches the girl's chin gently while talking, and they both smile in a friendly, intimate manner against the urban night backdrop. (8) The woman creator stands alone in the center of the frame, speaking directly to the camera with high energy. Her hands are gesturing frequently to emphasize her points as people walk by in the distant background. (9) A final cut shows a group of horror-themed cosplayers, including a zombie and someone holding an Annabelle-style doll. They all lean into the camera and scream with wide mouths and exaggerated fearful/menacing expressions. (10) The video ends with two text-based graphic screens featuring a dark red rectangle on a black background, first showing the date and then the song title.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video is filmed in a busy outdoor urban commercial district at night. Backgrounds feature modern glass department store buildings, illuminated signs (like H&M and Shinkitsu Mitsukoshi), string lights, and public walkways with various pedestrians.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female voice speaking Chinese over a bouncy, medium-tempo electronic pop BGM. A subtle 'whoosh' sound effect marks the quick visual transitions. The speaker's tone is enthusiastic and professional, with a high arousal level. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect occurs as the creator shows the tablet. The background music continues with a steady 4/4 beat. A male voice responds with a surprised and impressed tone, followed by the creator laughing lightly. (3) The vocal track features several short phrases from different interviewees reacting to the music. The BGM swells slightly during transitions. One male voice hums a melodic sequence 'Hung-en-hung-en' rhythmically to match the beat of the music. (4) The crowd noise increases slightly with clear sounds of collective laughter and a 'Ha ha ha' from the group in traditional costumes. The primary female voice maintains a dominant presence, speaking with clear articulation and rising intonation patterns. (5) A rhythmic 'pop' sound effect is heard during a fast visual montage. The female voice transitions into a monologue, summarizing the experience with a warm and confident tone. The music remains consistent in the background, providing a stable rhythmic floor. (6) The video concludes with a high-pitched, sudden collective scream from the horror-themed cosplayers, followed by a final musical stinger as the text screens appear. The audio quality is clean and professionally balanced throughout.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Series of Reactions -> Direct Address -> CTA -> Outro
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional tool for the creator's new single titled 'OH MY,' scheduled for release on December 12th. By conducting street interviews with diverse and visually striking cosplayers during a night event, the creator leverages their positive reactions to build social proof and anticipation for the song's catchy nature.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly mentions her new single, shows the MV/audio on a tablet, and includes a release date title card at the end.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses the vibrant atmosphere of a cosplay gathering to create a high-energy promotional clip. The fast-paced editing and inclusion of varied reactions cater to short-form social media trends.
